name: Get a weekly App Store and Google Play review digest in Gmail

parameters.content:
## 📱 Weekly app review digest — both stores, one email

### Who's it for
Anyone who ships a mobile app — indie developers, product managers and support teams who want to catch bad reviews before they pile up, without checking two store consoles every day.

### How it works
Every Monday at 8am the workflow pulls the week's newest reviews for your app from **both the Apple App Store and Google Play** (via two hosted Apify scrapers called over plain HTTP), keeps the last 7 days, then builds one HTML digest: review counts and average rating per store, plus the negative reviews that need a reply, quoted with author, version and date. Gmail sends it to you or your team.

### Requirements
- An [Apify](https://apify.com) account + API token (runs the two review scrapers)
- A Gmail account for sending

Scraping cost is per review delivered: [$0.0002 on the App Store](https://apify.com/beacondata/app-store-reviews-scraper), [$0.0001 on Google Play](https://apify.com/beacondata/google-play-reviews-scraper) — a typical 200+200-review week is about **$0.06**, and apps with no new reviews cost nothing. Each call carries a hard $1 cost cap.

If one store can't be read, the digest still goes out and says that store was unavailable, so a failure never looks like a quiet week. Gmail sends retry automatically; a failed run can be retried from Executions without re-running the scrapers.

### How to customize
Change the schedule, track a competitor's app id, lower the rating threshold for "needs attention", or send to Slack instead of Gmail.

## 🛠 How to set up

1. **Create an Apify account** at [apify.com](https://apify.com) (takes a minute, card not required) and copy your API token from **Console → Settings → API & Integrations**.
2. **Create the credential:** in n8n choose **Create credential → Header Auth** and set
   - Name: `Authorization`
   - Value: `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` (paste the token you copied in place of YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN)
   then select it on **Fetch App Store Reviews** and **Fetch Google Play Reviews** (both nodes use the same credential).
3. **Open **App Config**** and set your own values.
4. Pick your **Gmail** credential on the last node (or swap it for Slack, Outlook or SMTP — the finished HTML is in `{{ $json.html }}`).
5. Run it once with the test button, check the output, then activate.
